author: Slidebean
description:
Join Caya, CEO and Co-Founder of Slidebean, for a live, practical webinar focused on one of the most confusing parts of fundraising: startup valuation.

Valuation often feels like a black box, numbers get thrown around, assumptions aren’t always clear, and founders are left wondering how investors actually land on a price. This session is designed to make that process understandable and grounded in reality, especially for early-stage startups.

In this interactive session, you will:
✅ Walk through how startup valuations are typically formed.
✅ Identify what factors really matter at different stages.
✅ Know what parts of the equation founders can influence.
✅ How to approach valuation with clearer expectations.

This webinar is for founders who want a realistic valuation range before starting fundraising conversations, and who want to understand the trade-offs behind the numbers they’re discussing.
